newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish Jan CPI seen up 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish Jan CPI seen up 0.4 pct.

text.p: The Swedish consumer price index is expected to rise 0.4 percent in January, which corresponds to a year-on-year rate of 0.2 percent, a Reuters poll of ten analysts showed on Friday.
The forecasts range between 0.3 percent and 0.7 percent for the month, which correspond to a year-on-year rate of between zero percent and 0.4 percent.
In December 1996 consumer prices fell by 0.2 percent, which also meant an annual fall of 0.2 percent. In January last year consumer prices rose 0.1 percent, giving an annual rate of 2.0 percent.
Statistics Sweden will release January CPI figures on February 20 at 0815 GMT.
Analysts polled in the survey were from Aragon, Carnegie, Chase Manhattan Bank, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Handelsbanken, HCBC Midland, I.D.E.A, JP Morgan and S-E-Banken.
